offence_note: Robbery of wallet on SkyTrain, pushed complainant
sentence_quote: I would grant the extension of time to file the application for leave and I would grant leave to appeal, but I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Credit for 3.5 months pre-sentence custody applied two-for-one; exact figures not stated.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking several drugs; weapons for dangerous purpose
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of 12 months on each of the counts for which you have been convicted, followed by a period of probation. The sentences are to be served concurrently.

offence_note: Three counts of breaking and entering
sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent only that the sentence on Count 1 be reduced to four years and 57 days, with credit granted of 308 days for time spent in custody prior to sentencing
note: Prison total computed as 4y 57d plus 308 days credit; credit enhanced under Summers.

offence_note: Police officer assault causing bodily harm on detainee
sentence_quote: I impose a sentence of six months to be served in the community on Mr. Peters.
note: Offender is RCMP officer; victim Aboriginal; curfew about 60 days.

offence_note: Two counts of sexual assault on stepdaughter
sentence_quote: I impose a sentence of 21 months incarceration.
note: Conditional sentence rejected; SOIRA 20 years; weapons prohibition 10 years.

offence_note: Trafficking in 127 handguns with removed serial numbers
sentence_quote: a global sentence of four years is a fit and appropriate sentence to be served consecutively to the Counselling Sentences
note: Four years consecutive to 18 years already imposed for counselling murder offences.

offence_note: Residential break and enter, theft of valuables
sentence_quote: there will be a 21-month sentence together with a two-year probation order following that
note: No-contact with the Porritts agreed for probation.

offence_note: Armed robbery and attempted robbery with sawed-off shotgun
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal and set aside the judgment of the Court of Appeal. I would remit the matter to the sentencing judge for consideration of how much credit should be given to the appellant for the time served in pre-sentencing custody.
note: Matter remitted to sentencing judge to set credit; trial sentence was four years minimum.

offence_note: Armed robbery of store, owner beaten with bat
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; co-perpetrator sentenced separately.

sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent only that the sentence be reduced to 13 years and 197 days, giving Mr. Power's credit of 168 days for his pre-sentence custody
note: Appeal only adjusted pre-sentence credit to 1.5:1 under Summers.

offence_note: Sexual assault causing bodily harm, confinement, assault, threats, mischief against partner
sentence_quote: I would reduce the net sentence of seven years imposed by the trial judge to a net sentence of five years.
systemic_quote: I am of the view that as an Aboriginal person, your childhood has affected and has mitigated your moral culpability in this case.
note: Credit is one-year Downes bail-conditions credit; ancillary orders stand but not listed; Waseskun placement ordered by trial judge.
